reviews.location: Evercoast Dental - San Diego (San Diego, CA)
reviews.text:
Six-month cleaning at the San Diego office. Marisol, my hygienist, spotted early gum recession and showed me the probe readings on the screen instead of just reading numbers out loud.

Dr. Okafor stopped in, checked two older fillings, and said they could wait another year. The front desk booked my next visit and texted the confirmation before I reached the car.

Our four-year-old's first dental visit at Evercoast Kids in Oceanside. They let her ride the chair up and down and count her own teeth with a mirror before anyone picked up an instrument. Zero tears.

Dr. Salazar recommended fluoride varnish and gave us a printed brushing chart. The small reading corner in the waiting room kept her older brother busy.

reviews.location: Evercoast Dental - El Cajon (El Cajon, CA)
reviews.text:
Waited 35 minutes past my 8:00 appointment at El Cajon, and nobody explained why until I asked. The cleaning itself was fine, but I took time off work for this.

If mornings are overbooked, a text saying you're running late would go a long way.

reply.text:
Terrence, thank you for telling us, and we're sorry. This isn't the experience we want anyone to have with Evercoast Dental. A manager will reach out this week to make it right.

The Evercoast Dental patient care team

reviews.location: Evercoast Dental - San Jose (San Jose, CA)
reviews.text:
Cracked a molar on a Saturday, called Monday at 7:45, and San Jose fit me in by 10. Dr. Brandt was upfront that I needed a crown and gave me the out-of-pocket estimate on paper before starting the temporary.

Four stars only because the billing coordinator was out, so my financing questions had to wait for a callback.

reply.text:
Thanks so much, Colleen! We'll pass this along to the whole Evercoast Dental team. See you next time.

reviews.text:
Switched to the Gilbert office after moving across town. The new-patient visit included full x-rays, an oral cancer screening, and an honest conversation about my coffee habit. No upselling on whitening.

Online check-in actually worked, and my insurance was verified before I arrived.

Took my mom to the Logan office for a denture reline. Keoni, the assistant, was patient with her hearing and wrote the aftercare steps down for her. The shared parking lot is tight around noon, so plan for that.

reviews.location: Evercoast Dental - Park City (Park City, UT)
reviews.text:
I was charged for a fluoride treatment at Park City that nobody mentioned during the visit. When I called, the office said it was standard. It isn't standard if my plan doesn't cover it and I wasn't told.

The clinical care was gentle, but I'm disputing the charge.

reviews.text: Two years of perio maintenance every three months at the Oakland office. Joanna tracks my pocket depths and they've improved at almost every visit. The text reminders the day before are spot on.

reviews.text: The bilingual team at Tempe made my dad's extraction so much easier. Dr. Ibarra explained everything in Spanish, called him that evening to check on swelling, and the post-op sheet came in both languages.
My night guard from the Parker office fit on the first try. A small pressure point on the left side was fixed in five minutes at a quick follow-up. Fair price compared with the other quote I got.

Booked a cleaning online for the Provo office and showed up to find the appointment had never been confirmed. They found a hygienist to see me after a 20-minute wait, but the online booking needs fixing.

reviews.text: Brought all three kids to Ogden on one afternoon. They ran two chairs side by side so we were in and out in an hour, and Dr. Lindgren gave each kid one thing to work on instead of a lecture.

The implant consult at Surprise covered the 3D scan, the bone graft question, and a staged timeline in one visit. I left with a written estimate and two financing options, with no pressure to decide that day.
